title: Gap between sonic-swss and sonic-sairedis VS testing
author: daall
body:
#1399 introduced a bug (see #1403) that was not caught by the VS testing on the PR or by any of the subsequent canary builds. However, it was caught by the sonic-sairedis nightly tests.

Example: https://sonic-jenkins.westus2.cloudapp.azure.com/job/vs/job/sonic-sairedis-build/1199/

Need to figure out why this was triggered in the `sairedis` test pipeline and not `swss`.

linkedPullRequests.title: [vs] Fix issue of swss debian being overwritten by sairedis
linkedPullRequests.author: daall
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>

Fixes Azure/sonic-swss#1404

The addition of `sonic-sairedis` VS testing (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-build-tools/pull/133) led to `swss_1.0.0_amd64.deb` being added to the list of `sairedis` artifacts. Because of this change, the artifacts from `sairedis`, which is based on the latest `swss`, were overwriting the PR-built `swss` package.

This change narrows the list of artifacts being copied for the DVS build so that this does not happen again in the future. It also moves the swss install to the end.

```
cp libsaimetadata-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsaimetadata-dev_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsaimetadata_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsairedis-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsairedis-dev_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsairedis_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsaivs-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsaivs-dev_1.0.0_amd64.deb libsaivs_1.0.0_amd64.deb swss-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb swss_1.0.0_amd64.deb syncd-vs-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb syncd-vs_1.0.0_amd64.deb scripts/vs/sonic-sairedis-build/docker-sonic-vs/debs

cp common/libswsscommon-dbg_1.0.0_amd64.deb common/libswsscommon-dev_1.0.0_amd64.deb common/libswsscommon_1.0.0_amd64.deb common/python-swsscommon_1.0.0_amd64.deb common/python3-swsscommon_1.0.0_amd64.deb scripts/vs/sonic-sairedis-build/docker-sonic-vs/debs
```

Verified that only the necessary packages are copied, and the order is correct. Waiting on the test result to verify that the acl ERRORs are not related to this PR.
